title.narrative: EU for Integrity - The Open Government Partnership (OGP) Action for the Eastern Partnership

description.narrative: The overall objective of the EU for Integrity Action for the Eastern Partnership Programme is to provide assistance to the EaP countries to prevent and combat threats to the rule of law, and to support justice and public administration reform. This Action focuses on the supply and demand-side of the necessary reforms, to foster evidence-based anti-corruption policy implementation through regional analysis and experience-sharing, to support stepping-up the enforcement of legislation.
